VoxCanvas-41M
	

A Large-Scale Bilingual Dataset for Instruction-Based Speech Editing and Its Learning Dynamics
   


VoxCanvas-41M is a large-scale bilingual (Chinese and English) dataset for instruction-based speech editing. It
contains about 41 million editing pairs built from real speech, in two categories, and also releases refined Emilia
transcripts:

Content editing: single-span editing, multi-span editing (two to six edits in one instruction), and
location-reference… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/zkniu/VoxCanvas.
